rush_and_cap_ok: true
└─ order.is_rush and discount_within_cap
   ├─ order.is_rush: true
   │  └─ is_express and estimated_delivery_days <= 2
   │     ├─ is_express: true
   │     └─ estimated_delivery_days <= 2
   │        └─ estimated_delivery_days: 1
   │           └─ is_express
   └─ discount_within_cap: true
      └─ order.savings_percent <= config.max_discount_cap
         ├─ order.savings_percent: 30%
         │  └─ (savings_total / subtotal) as percent
         │     └─ savings_total / subtotal
         │        ├─ savings_total: 300
         │        │  └─ discount_amount + loyalty_discount
         │        │     ├─ discount_amount: 300
         │        │     │  └─ subtotal * combined_discount_rate
         │        │     │     ├─ subtotal: 1000
         │        │     │     │  └─ base_price * quantity
         │        │     │     │     ├─ base_price: 100
         │        │     │     │     └─ quantity: 10
         │        │     │     └─ combined_discount_rate: 30%
         │        │     │        ├─ tier_discount_rate > measure_discount_rate
         │        │     │        │  ├─ tier_discount_rate: 30%
         │        │     │        │  │  └─ customer_tier is vip
         │        │     │        │  │     └─ is_vip: true
         │        │     │        │  │        └─ customer_tier is vip
         │        │     │        │  │           └─ customer_tier: vip
         │        │     │        │  └─ measure_discount_rate: 5%
         │        │     │        │     ├─ quantity < 50
         │        │     │        │     │  └─ quantity: 10
         │        │     │        │     ├─ quantity < 100
         │        │     │        │     │  └─ quantity: 10
         │        │     │        │     └─ quantity >= 10
         │        │     │        │        └─ quantity: 10
         │        │     │        └─ tier_discount_rate
         │        │     │           └─ tier_discount_rate: 30% (see above)
         │        │     └─ loyalty_discount: 0
         │        │        └─ net_price * loyalty_discount_rate
         │        │           ├─ net_price: 700
         │        │           │  └─ subtotal - discount_amount
         │        │           │     ├─ subtotal: 1000 (see above)
         │        │           │     └─ discount_amount: 300 (see above)
         │        │           └─ loyalty_discount_rate: 0%
         │        │              ├─ loyalty_points < 1000
         │        │              │  └─ loyalty_points: 0
         │        │              ├─ loyalty_points < 5000
         │        │              │  └─ loyalty_points: 0
         │        │              └─ loyalty_points < 10000
         │        │                 └─ loyalty_points: 0
         │        └─ subtotal: 1000 (see above)
         └─ config.max_discount_cap: 35%
